# Usage

This page assumes that you have [installed](../installation/index.qmd) synthclient and [signed up](../signup/index.qmd), so that you now have a _synth token_ (.st).

If you have installed the `synthclient` binary locally, you can run these commands:

```sh
echo "your passphrase here" > token.passphrase
synthclient --port 8080 \
    --token-file token.st \
    --keypair-file token.priv \
    --keypair-passphrase-file token.passphrase &
```

Here, _token.st_ and _token.priv_ are the files you downloaded in @sec-generating-synth-tokens and the passphrase is the _passphrase B_ you picked for this synth token.
